017package org.apache.juneau.commons.svl;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.lang.reflect.*;
022import java.util.*;
023
024/**
025 * Reflection-based base class for {@link VarFunction} implementations that prefer typed
026 * argument signatures over manual {@code List<Object>} unpacking.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * Subclasses declare one or more public {@code invoke(...)} methods whose parameter lists mirror
030 * the function's expected arguments. Per-arg target types and arities are derived once at
031 * construction via reflection; per-call dispatch picks the matching overload by argument count
032 * and runs one reflective invoke + N {@link ArgCoercer} coercions.
033 *
034 * <h5 class='section'>Method-resolution rules:</h5>
035 * <ul>
036 *    <li>The subclass declares one or more public methods named {@code invoke}. Each must have a
037 *       distinct fixed-arity (or be the single variadic overload — see below).
038 *    <li>The return type must be {@code String} (or a subtype convertible via
039 *       {@link Object#toString()}).
040 *    <li>Parameter types may be any of: {@code String}, {@code int}, {@code long}, {@code double},
041 *       {@code boolean} (or their wrappers), {@code String[]}, or {@code Object}. The final slot
042 *       may be {@code String[]} for variadic functions.
043 *    <li>If the subclass needs the {@link VarResolverSession session} (e.g. to look up beans),
044 *       declare {@code VarResolverSession} as the <i>first</i> parameter.
045 *    <li>At most one variadic overload (final {@code String[]} slot) per subclass; combined with
046 *       fixed-arity overloads as long as the arity counts don't overlap.
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <h5 class='section'>Example — multi-arity:</h5>
050 * <p class='bjava'>
051 *    <jk>public class</jk> Substring <jk>extends</jk> TypedFunction {
052 *       <ja>@Override</ja> <jk>public</jk> String name() { <jk>return</jk> <js>"substring"</js>; }
053 *       <jk>public</jk> String invoke(String <jv>s</jv>, <jk>int</jk> <jv>start</jv>) { <jk>return</jk> <jv>s</jv>.substring(<jv>start</jv>); }
054 *       <jk>public</jk> String invoke(String <jv>s</jv>, <jk>int</jk> <jv>start</jv>, <jk>int</jk> <jv>end</jv>) { <jk>return</jk> <jv>s</jv>.substring(<jv>start</jv>, <jv>end</jv>); }
055 *    }
056 * </p>
057 */
058@SuppressWarnings({
059   "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for the reflection-driven dispatch.
060})
061public abstract class TypedFunction implements VarFunction {
062
063   /**
064    * Per-overload reflection metadata.
065    *
066    * @param method The reflected {@code invoke} method.
067    * @param argTypes The argument types, excluding any leading session arg.
068    * @param takesSession Whether the method takes a leading {@link VarResolverSession} argument.
069    * @param variadic Whether the final argument slot is a variadic {@code String[]}.
070    */
071   private record Overload(Method method, Class<?>[] argTypes, boolean takesSession, boolean variadic) {
072
073      /** Arg count excluding the variadic slot. */
074      int fixedCount() {
075         return variadic ? argTypes.length - 1 : argTypes.length;
076      }
077
078      boolean acceptsArity(int n) {
079         if (variadic)
080            return n >= fixedCount();
081         return n == fixedCount();
082      }
083
084      @Override /* Content-based: the 'argTypes' array must compare by content, not identity (S6218). */
085      public boolean equals(Object o) {
086         return o instanceof Overload x
087            && Objects.equals(method, x.method)
088            && Arrays.equals(argTypes, x.argTypes)
089            && takesSession == x.takesSession
090            && variadic == x.variadic;
091      }
092
093      @Override
094      public int hashCode() {
095         return 31 * Objects.hash(method, takesSession, variadic) + Arrays.hashCode(argTypes);
096      }
097
098      @Override /* Renders the 'argTypes' array by content rather than identity (S6218). */
099      public String toString() {
100         return "Overload[method=" + method + ", argTypes=" + Arrays.toString(argTypes) + ", takesSession=" + takesSession + ", variadic=" + variadic + "]";
101      }
102   }
103
104   /** All declared {@code invoke} overloads, sorted by descending arity for predictable matching. */
105   private final Overload[] overloads;
106   private final int minArity;
107   private final int maxArity;
108
109   protected TypedFunction() {
110      this.overloads = findInvokeOverloads(getClass());
111      var lo = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
112      var hi = 0;
113      var anyVariadic = false;
114      for (var o : overloads) {
115         if (o.variadic()) {
116            anyVariadic = true;
117            lo = Math.min(lo, o.fixedCount());
118         } else {
119            lo = Math.min(lo, o.fixedCount());
120            hi = Math.max(hi, o.fixedCount());
121         }
122      }
123      this.minArity = lo == Integer.MAX_VALUE ? 0 : lo;
124      this.maxArity = anyVariadic ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : hi;
125   }
126
127   @Override
128   public final int minArity() { return minArity; }
129
130   @Override
131   public final int maxArity() { return maxArity; }
132
133   @Override
134   public final String invoke(VarResolverSession session, List<Object> args) {
135      var n = args.size();
136      Overload o = null;
137      for (var c : overloads) {
138         if (c.acceptsArity(n)) { o = c; break; }
139      }
140      if (o == null)
141         throw iaex("Function '%s' has no overload accepting %s argument(s)", name(), n);
142
143      var coerced = ArgCoercer.coerce(name(), o.argTypes(), args);
144      try {
145         Object[] effective;
146         if (o.takesSession()) {
147            effective = new Object[coerced.length + 1];
148            effective[0] = session;
149            System.arraycopy(coerced, 0, effective, 1, coerced.length);
150         } else {
151            effective = coerced;
152         }
153         var result = o.method().invoke(this, effective);
154         return result == null ? "" : result.toString();
155      } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
156         var cause = e.getTargetException();
157         if (cause instanceof RuntimeException cause2)
158            throw cause2;
159         throw iaex("Function '%s' threw %s: %s", name(), cns(cause), cause.getMessage());
160      } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
161         throw iaex("Function '%s' invoke method must be public: %s", name(), e.getMessage());
162      }
163   }
164
165   private static Overload[] findInvokeOverloads(Class<? extends TypedFunction> cls) {
166      var found = new ArrayList<Overload>();
167      for (var m : cls.getMethods()) {
168         if (!"invoke".equals(m.getName())
169            || m.getDeclaringClass() == TypedFunction.class
170            || m.getDeclaringClass() == Object.class
171            || m.getDeclaringClass() == VarFunction.class)
172            continue;
173         var allParams = m.getParameterTypes();
174         var takesSession = allParams.length > 0 && allParams[0] == VarResolverSession.class;
175         var startIdx = takesSession ? 1 : 0;
176         var argTypes = Arrays.copyOfRange(allParams, startIdx, allParams.length);
177         var variadic = argTypes.length > 0 && argTypes[argTypes.length - 1] == String[].class;
178         found.add(new Overload(m, argTypes, takesSession, variadic));
179      }
180      if (found.isEmpty())
181         throw iaex("TypedFunction subclass %s must declare a public invoke(...) method", cls.getName());
182      // Sort by descending fixedCount so larger arity overloads get matched before any
183      // variadic overload they might overlap with.
184      found.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b.fixedCount(), a.fixedCount()));
185      return found.toArray(new Overload[0]);
186   }
187}
